captions.detailed: A sleek, black gaming monitor featuring a wide rectangular display panel with a thin bezel and a small power button centered along its bottom edge. The screen is mounted onto a vertical, telescoping support column that rises from a stable, V-shaped tripod base. The monitor is fully articulated, allowing for height adjustment via the telescoping column, horizontal panning (swivel) at the base joint, vertical tilt at the mounting head, and full 90-degree rotation (portrait-to-landscape) behind the panel.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of an articulated gaming monitor. The model should include a V-shaped tripod base, a vertical telescoping stand for height adjustment, and a wide flat-screen display panel that supports swivel, tilt, and portrait rotation, complete with a small front power button.
captions.factory: Construct the base using cylinders for the central joint and angled cylindrical legs. Build the vertical stand using nested rectangular boxes to represent the telescoping column segments. Create the screen assembly by combining a thin box for the main panel, a recessed box for the display area, and a small box for the power button. Define the assembly joints, using revolute and prismatic joints to connect the base, column segments, tilt head, and screen panel to enable multi-axis articulation.
